verdict.rationale: The evidence shows inbound HTTP endpoints (httpAction, public HTTP API), WebSocket-based reactive sync, and log streaming as a pricing-page feature. None of these documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a consumer can subscribe to for events. Inbound endpoints and real-time client sync are adjacent features, not webhook subscriptions, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
